changes: Notes refined: the corruption is most likely v for m (śrīman-vādhava- for śrīman-mādhava-); added that '-rāja' may be an honorific rather than part of the name.
Notes: this is a chapter colophon only, with no scribe, date or place.

notes: This is the colophon at the end of chapter 5 (sarga 5) and gives no scribe, date or place. The author's name is written 'śrīmanvādhavānandarāja', which most likely reads śrīman-mādhavānandarāja (v miswritten or misread for m). The '-rāja' could be an honorific rather than part of the name, which would make the name Mādhavānanda. 'subhāsābhūṣite' probably stands for subhāṣā-bhūṣite. The catalogue title 'Sukhārṇāvārthaprakāśa' should read Sukhārṇavārthaprakāśa, as in the colophon.
